title: SoL configuration
description: Configuration file of the sol listener (version 1). Unknown keys are rejected at start-up, so every object here sets additionalProperties to false. Field reference: docs/routing-design.md (字段速查).

version.description: Schema version; the only accepted value is 1.

server.description: Interfaces, per-interface blocks, rules and the control plane.

interfaces.description: Interfaces to match on. Omit or leave empty to auto-select every eligible interface (up, non-loopback, has a MAC, not virtual). An entry is either a bare name or a block with per-interface overrides.

rules.description: Rules applied to every interface of this instance. Top-level rules are an equivalent shorthand; setting both is an error.

watch.description: Poll the configuration file and reload it when it changes. Empty or "0" disables watching; the minimum interval is 1s.

http.description: HTTP control plane. Disabled unless enabled is true; it binds 127.0.0.1:8080 by default and always requires authentication.

listen.description: host:port to bind, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8080. Prefer a loopback address unless TLS and mTLS are configured.

type.description: Authentication scheme; empty means bearer. There is no unauthenticated mode.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the bearer token (bearer only).

token_file.description: 0600 file holding the bearer token (bearer only; alternative to token_env).

password_env.description: Environment variable holding the password (basic only).

password_file.description: 0600 file holding the password (basic only; alternative to password_env).

tls.description: TLS material. Required for mtls (client_ca_file) and implied by cert_file/key_file.

client_ca_file.description: CA bundle verifying client certificates (mtls only).

level.description: Log level; empty and "warning" are accepted as info and warn respectively. Defaults to info.

format.description: Log format; empty defaults to text.

security.description: Guards: dry-run, reserved ports, cooldowns, allow-lists and the remote command channel.

dry_run.description: Log matching packets instead of executing their action.

reserved_ports.description: Ports reserved for plain Wake-on-LAN; defaults to [7, 9]. They accept only a payload-free magic packet and can only run noop.

allow_reserved_port_actions.description: Allow non-noop actions on the reserved ports (the pre-rule-model behaviour). Defaults to false.

secure_on.description: SecureOn password expected after the magic packet: 6 bytes, either 12 hex characters (aabbccddeeff) or 6 ASCII characters.

exec_allowlist.description: Directories that absolute exec command paths must live under; empty allows any absolute path.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between two executions of the same action; empty disables it.

cooldowns.description: Per-action cooldown overrides, keyed by action name (built-in names, configured names, or remote:<id>).

allow_remote_commands.description: Enable the remote command channel. Off by default; enabling it requires remote_command_auth and at least one non-reserved remote_command_ports entry.

remote_command_auth.description: Shared HMAC key authenticating remote command segments. The key never lives in this file.

key_env.description: Environment variable holding the shared key.

key_file.description: 0600 file holding the shared key (alternative to key_env).

remote_command_ports.description: UDP ports that accept remote command segments. They are bound but never matched against rules; reserved ports are refused.

url_allowlist.description: Destinations outbound HTTP actions may reach. A plain entry is a prefix matched on scheme+host with a path boundary, '=' makes it an exact whole-URL match and '~' makes it a regular expression. A malformed entry fails the start-up.

actions.description: Named actions referenced by rules and by POST /v1/actions/{name}.

commands.description: Whitelisted remote commands; each one is registered as the action remote:<id>.

rules.description: Shorthand for server.rules. Setting both is an error.

interfaceBlock.description: Per-interface overrides: dry_run applies to this interface, secure_on is not implemented yet, and rules are scoped to it.

name.description: Interface name; a block requires it.

dry_run.description: Log matches on this interface instead of executing them; requires block-level rules.

secure_on.description: Per-interface SecureOn password; not implemented yet, setting it is an error.

rules.description: Rules scoped to this interface; they implicitly match this interface only.

action.description: Action to run: a built-in name, a configured actions[].name or remote:<id>.

dry_run.description: Log the match instead of executing the action.

match.description: Conditions a packet must satisfy. An empty match is accepted.

ports.description: Destination UDP ports this rule listens on.

interfaces.description: Interface names this rule applies to.

mac.description: Target MAC selector: the literal strings "self" or "any", a MAC address, or a block.

oneOf.description: "self" (this host's MACs), "any", or an explicit MAC address such as 58:11:22:bc:78:66.

src_cidrs.description: Source networks allowed to trigger this rule, e.g. 192.168.0.0/24 or 10.0.0.1/32.

interfaces.description: Interface names whose MACs match, for kind: interface.

content.description: Payload matching after the magic packet (and SecureOn, when configured). value and value_hex are mutually exclusive; kind any and none take no value at all, and offset only applies to prefix.

kind.description: How the payload is compared: any accepts any payload, none requires an empty one, suffix/prefix match the token at the end or the start of the payload area.

value_hex.description: Payload token as hex (e.g. 00ff10); mutually exclusive with value.

offset.description: Offset inside the payload area for prefix matching.

action.description: A named action. The parameters must match the type: exec takes command/timeout/workdir/env/shell/user/group, http takes method/url/headers/body/timeout/retries, sequence takes steps.

command.description: argv of an exec action; not a shell string unless shell is true.

workdir.description: Working directory of an exec action.

env.description: Extra environment entries (KEY=VALUE) for an exec action; values may interpolate {{.Arg.x}}.

user.description: Run as this user (name or id); requires root and is validated at start-up. exec and remote commands only.

group.description: Run as this group (name or id); requires root. exec and remote commands only.

shell.description: Run the command through /bin/sh -c (exec only). An escape hatch; argv is the default.

method.description: HTTP method of an http action; defaults to POST.

url.description: Destination of an http action; supports {{.Action}}/{{.SrcIP}}/{{.DstPort}}/{{.Arg.x}} interpolation in the query and path, while scheme and host stay literal.

headers.description: Request headers of an http action; values may interpolate, and they are never logged.

body.description: Request body of an http action; may interpolate.

retries.description: Retry count of an http action (transport failures, 429 and 5xx only).

steps.description: Ordered action names of a sequence; every step runs even when an earlier one fails. Nesting a sequence inside a sequence is refused.

command.description: One whitelisted remote command. It becomes the action remote:<id> and keeps the exec parameters.

id.description: Command id (1-32 characters of A-Za-z0-9_.-); the action name is remote:<id>.

command.description: argv of the command; {{.Arg.<name>}} interpolates validated arguments, never a shell string.

args.description: Argument specs, keyed by argument name.

user.description: Run as this user (name or id); requires root and is validated at start-up.

group.description: Run as this group (name or id); requires root.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match.

required.description: Whether the sender must supply the argument; defaults to true.
